text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wha! Wh-What is this power welling up from 
deep within my body...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No way... Great Three Goddesses, is this 
your divine work...?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much for your 
cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I shall put this strength to good use 
helping others and become an even better 
role model!
